description: This PHP class defines the I18NGroupModel, an API model for representing internationalization groups related to the Admin module in the OrangeHRM system. It implements serialization and normalization features via traits and is constructed using an I18NGroup entity.

classes.name: I18NGroupModel
classes.description: API model class for I18NGroup entity, providing schema definition and serialization capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an I18NGroup entity and sets up attribute filters and names.
